purpose: Consistent generated references for Hunyuan multi-view character reconstruction; not measured official turnarounds

prompts.front: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single FRONT orthographic full-body character reference image for a consistent multi-view 3D reconstruction of Suzume Iwato from Suzume. Input image 1 is the authoritative FACE and hair-pin identity reference, input image 2 is authoritative BACK clothing/hair reference, image 3 is authoritative SIDE clothing silhouette reference. Make exactly ONE full-body character, front facing, plain pure white background, no text, no other views, no props, no ground shadow, entire shoes and top hair visible with 8% clear margins. Faithful clean Japanese anime cel-shaded model-sheet drawing, coherent 3D anatomy and modest original school uniform, natural teenage proportions about 7 heads tall, NOT chibi, no redesign. Match face eyes and fringe to reference 1; chestnut dark brown hair tied into a long high ponytail reaching upper-back, red crossed hairpins plus one gold straight pin on her anatomical LEFT fringe (viewer's right), two short curved flyaway hairs. White short-sleeved button shirt tucked into muted olive-green pleated knee-length skirt; two olive green bands around each sleeve with a white strip between, white pointed collar, thin red ribbon bow at neck, small plain olive school badge on chest. Navy high calf socks, dark brown low loafers with a narrow pale sole edge. Thin gold and red bracelets only on her anatomical LEFT wrist. Neutral closed-mouth calm face looking straight ahead. Modeling pose: symmetrical relaxed A-pose, straight torso, legs straight and feet hip-width apart pointing forward, both arms straight 25 degrees out from vertical, palms facing inward and fingers naturally separated, arms clear of torso and skirt. Ponytail hangs behind, no wind. All later views will use this exact body pose. Flat neutral daylight, restrained two-tone cel shading, clear fine outlines, no cinematic colored lighting. Prioritize identity consistency, actual clothing and full unoccluded silhouette.
prompts.back:
Use case: identity-preserve. Create one single full-body orthographic 3D modeling reference image of the EXACT SAME Suzume character in image 1. Image 1 is the approved front-view identity, exact proportions, clothing, colors and fixed A-pose; image 2 is the film's back view for ponytail/shirt/skirt construction only, NOT the pose. She stays perfectly still in that exact relaxed A-pose, arms 25 degrees from vertical, legs straight hip-width apart. Only the camera viewpoint changes as specified below. Maintain all landmark heights and original 1024x1536 portrait framing, whole hair and shoes, white background, no floor, no ground shadows, no text, no contact sheet. Exact white short sleeve shirt with TWO olive green bands separated by white around EACH sleeve, thin red neck ribbon on FRONT only, small olive shield on anatomical LEFT chest only, olive knee length pleated skirt, navy socks, dark loafers with pale narrow sole. Red/gold bracelets on anatomical LEFT wrist only. Same ponytail reaching upper back, no added hair ornaments. Same restrained Japanese anime cel drawing and flat neutral diffuse light. Keep contours crisp and actual teenage natural proportions, modest clothing.
Camera directly BEHIND her, perfectly straight rear view at 180 degrees. The two hands and back of shirt visible; ponytail centered on the back, no bow or chest badge visible from rear. Her LEFT wrist bracelet now appears at image LEFT. Rear view of heels, both feet still point away. The ponytail should hang straight down upper back as the back film reference, broad at top tapered at end. No face or second face on back of head.
